submission.justification: Mixture-G3 at 1.5 mm gap is recommended as the only configuration that reliably meets all project requirements. While Mixture-G2 would deliver superior time resolution (0.899 ns at 2.0 mm), it is described as a "standard fluorinated mixture" which typically has GWP100 values exceeding 1000, far above the mandatory limit of 150. Mixture-G3, described as based on "newer replacement gases," was explicitly designed for environmental compliance and is the only mixture clearly meeting the hard GWP100 ≤ 150 constraint. At 1.5 mm gap, G3 achieves its optimal time resolution of 2.051 ns. Although this represents a 56% performance penalty compared to the unconstrained optimum, environmental compliance is non-negotiable per laboratory policy. The 1.5 mm gap is well within the allowed 1-3 mm range and represents the best achievable time resolution while satisfying all mandatory constraints.
